policy_notes: Normalized Cash Power is an analytical run-rate diagnostic, not reported FCF, FCFF, a forecast, or fair value.
Working capital uses a comparative-delta policy and therefore preserves the prior comparable working-capital cash pattern instead of assuming zero working-capital needs.
The cash-tax timing adjustment normalizes only the current-vs-prior comparable delta; it does not add back all cash taxes.
Stock-based compensation is deducted as an economic cost in this model; no equivalent dilution charge may be applied again.
Annualization is mechanical and does not assert a full-year outcome.
